_comment: Tier-1 mcp_tool source preset for spark-mcp (AU-KG.ingest.mcp-tool-connector). Syncs the recorded TransformRun ledger into the KG via the spark-mcp MCP server. spark_list_transform_runs is the only read-only spark_* tool with no required arguments (limit defaults to 100, transform is an optional name filter) -- spark_list_lakekeeper_tables requires a namespace the sync pipeline has no way to supply, spark_sql/spark_submit_transform/spark_rerun_transform mutate or need a caller-supplied query/manifest, and spark_lineage_config/spark_application_status return a single status object, not a list of records. Contributed presets win over the central MCP_TOOL_PRESETS.
